situation: A Folio opened while the currency changes
given: a Property with no Folio yet
when: a check-in opens its first Folio while another Staff Member saves a new currency
then: the two serialise on the Property row: whichever commits second is refused, so no Folio is ever committed in a currency its Property no longer trades in (ADR 0015). A losing currency change is told the currency is fixed; a losing check-in fails with the generic error and succeeds when retried

situation: A change that reopens a closed day

when: a Staff Member saves a timezone or cutoff that would date today on or before it
then: refused by close the day's guard with RZ001, and shown as that refusal in the reader's language, keeping the draft, with focus on the time zone when only it changed and on the cutoff otherwise; a name change alone still saves

situation: A save and a check-in at once
given: a check-in holding the Property's advisory lock shared
then: the save takes the Property's advisory lock before touching the row, so the two lock in one order and never deadlock; the id is hashed in its canonical form, as the guard hashes it. The lock is taken through a read of the Property row, so somebody who cannot see the Property locks nothing and is refused at once rather than holding up its check-ins
